name: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome
definition: Pain arising from the patellofemoral region, typically aggravated by activities that load the patellofemoral joint such as squatting, stairs or prolonged sitting.

typical: Pain with stairs, squats or running

investigations.MRI: MRI only for atypical/refractory symptoms or alternative pathology.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs if structural disease is suspected.

amber: Taping/orthoses may help selected patients but should complement exercise.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-shoola phenotype may be documented as a correlation.

patientEducation.summary: Pain arising from the patellofemoral region, typically aggravated by activities that load the patellofemoral joint such as squatting, stairs or prolonged sitting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
